content.short: Carnegie Mellon Blockchain is a CMU-based community promoting blockchain education, knowledge sharing, and collaboration.
content.description: Carnegie Mellon Blockchain is a community of blockchain enthusiasts at Carnegie Mellon University. Its mission is to help make blockchain mainstream by educating CMU students about blockchain technology and its wide range of applications. The group brings CMU students together to share knowledge, collaborate on blockchain projects, and learn from each other. Members participate in events, workshops, and hackathons to gain hands-on experience and build practical skills.
